teamFit.intro: The role matches your team members found for themselves, shown only where they have shared them with you. Nothing is scored here.
teamFit.advisory: A match score is one input for a development conversation. It is not a hiring, pay or performance decision.
teamFit.notOn: Team fit is not switched on for your organization.
teamFit.noSearchResults: No team member matches that search.
teamFit.rosterError: Your team could not be loaded. This is a loading problem, not an empty team.
teamFit.rosterEmpty: You have no team members in Team Development Studio yet. Add them there first.
teamFit.matchesError: {{name}}'s matches could not be loaded just now. That is not the same as having none.

notShared.title: Not shared
notShared.both: {{name}} has not shared their PRISM profile or Development with you. Role matches need both, so they stay private until {{name}} shares them.
notShared.development: {{name}} has not shared Development with you. Role matches sit under Development, so they stay private until {{name}} shares it.
notShared.prism: {{name}} has not shared their PRISM profile with you. Role matches come from it, so they stay private until {{name}} shares it.
notShared.unspecified: {{name}} has not shared their role matches with you. They stay private until {{name}} shares them.

teamFit.noAccount: {{name}} does not have an InspiresGenius account yet, so there are no matches to show.
teamFit.noPrism: {{name}} has no PRISM profile on file yet. Role matches are measured from it.
teamFit.notEntitled: Career Fit is not switched on for {{name}}, so there are no matches to show.

noMatches.title: No matches yet
noMatches.notRun: {{name}} has not opened their own Career Fit matches yet. They appear here after {{name}} does. Nothing is scored from this page.
noMatches.noRoles: {{name}}'s own Career Fit had no published roles to compare against.
noMatches.notRunOnDemand: {{name}} has not opened their own Career Fit matches yet. They appear here after {{name}} does.

teamFit.unknownState: {{name}}'s matches cannot be shown right now.
teamFit.asOf: From {{name}}'s own Career Fit, as of {{date}}.
teamFit.introOnDemand: The role matches your team members found for themselves, shown only where they have shared them with you. Where it is switched on, you can also score a member against a role you choose. A record is kept and the member is told.

onDemand.title: Score against a role
onDemand.intro: Scores {{name}} against a role you choose, from their PRISM profile. A record is kept, and {{name}} is told on their own Career Fit page that you viewed their fit for that role.
onDemand.noRoles: There is no published role that both you and {{name}} can see, so there is nothing to score against.
onDemand.rolesError: We could not check whether you can score {{name}} against a role. This is a loading problem.
onDemand.scoreError: {{name}} could not be scored just now. That is not a score of zero. Try again.
onDemand.resultNote: Scored just now at your request. It is not added to {{name}}'s own fit reports, and {{name}} can see that you viewed it.
onDemand.notShared: Scoring {{name}} against a role needs {{name}} to have shared both their PRISM profile and Development with you.
onDemand.roleNotAvailable: That role can no longer be scored for {{name}}. Choose another.
onDemand.off: Scoring against a role is not switched on for {{name}}'s organization.
onDemand.unknownState: Scoring {{name}} against a role is not available right now.
